title: A few Autumnal paintings
description: OK, so I missed the 2026 Autumnal Equinox by two days, but I can still celebrate. Here are a few paintings of Autumn landscapes, mostly from the 19th century. title: Eye Candy for Today: M.J. Galt pencil portrait
description: Alex, by M.J. Galt, pencil on paper. I don’t know the size. Link is to image file page on Wikimedia Commons. Original is in the Library of Congress. title: Julian Merrow-Smith – Postcard from Provence (update)
description: One of my favorite contemporary painters is a British painter who has been living and painting in the south of France for many years. In 2005, he became one of the earliest artists to adopt the practice of “Painting a Day”, (perhaps second, not long after the originator of that idea Duane Keiser). This calls […]
